attrs.label: How we run your TikTok Ads
attrs.html:
How we run your TikTok Ads

The same clear rhythm on every account, run by people you can talk to, so you always know what’s happening and why.

  1. Week 1

    Audit and goals

    We go through your TikTok Ads account, tracking and landing pages, and work out what it really brings in today.

    • Spend, campaigns and search terms reviewed line by line
    • Tracking checked against your CRM or store
    • Landing pages tested on phone and desktop
    • A written audit with a 90-day plan

    Your part: A 45-minute kick-off call about your customers, margins and what a good lead is worth.

  2. Week 2

    Tracking and setup

    Pixel and Events API set up and tested, TikTok Shop connected.

    • Conversion actions set up and tested
    • Values for each lead or sale agreed with you
    • Dashboards connected to your data
    • Account structure planned

    Your part: Give us access to your ad account, analytics and website tags.

  3. Weeks 3–4

    Launch

    The new campaign structure, audiences, ads and landing pages go live, with budgets agreed in writing.

    • New campaigns built next to the old ones, then switched over
    • Ads written and designed in-house
    • Landing pages built or improved by our web team
    • Budgets and targets agreed before anything goes live

    Your part: Approve the ads, the pages and the budget. Nothing launches without your OK.

  4. Every week

    Optimise

    New videos, Spark ads, audiences and budgets.

    • Wasted spend cut
    • Bids and budgets moved to what works
    • One test at a time, so we know what made the difference
    • A short written update every week

    Your part: Tell us about leads that turned into customers, or didn’t.

  5. Every month

    Report and plan

    A plain-English report on leads, sales and cost per result, what we learned and what we’ll test next.

    • A report you can forward to your boss
    • What worked, what didn’t and why
    • The plan and budget for next month

    Your part: A 30-minute call with your specialist. Bring questions, and anyone else who should hear it.

attrs.label: How to choose a TikTok Ads agency
attrs.html:
How to choose a TikTok Ads agency

What to expect from a good agency, what to avoid, and the questions worth asking before you hand over your budget.

What you get with us

  • Ads run in your account. You own it, the data and the history
  • Conversion tracking is checked and tested before we scale spend
  • Monthly reports in leads, sales and cost per result, not just clicks
  • A named specialist who knows your account, not a rotating team
  • A written plan for the first 90 days before we start

What we never do

  • Lock you into long contracts or keep your account if you leave
  • Take a hidden cut of your ad spend
  • Report impressions and clicks as if they were results
  • Promise rankings, results or approval from the platform
  • Change budgets or targeting without telling you

Questions to ask any TikTok Ads agency

Ask every agency you speak to, including us. The answers tell you more than any proposal.

  1. Q1

    Who will manage my account day to day?

    Why ask: Many agencies sell with senior people and hand the work to juniors. You want to know who makes the changes, and how much experience they have.

  2. Q2

    Will the account be in my name, and do I keep it if we part ways?

    Why ask: Your account history is valuable. If the agency owns the account, you can lose years of data and learning when you leave.

  3. Q3

    How do you charge, and do you take a percentage of ad spend?

    Why ask: A percentage of spend rewards spending more, not spending well. Know exactly what you pay and what it covers.

  4. Q4

    How will you check our conversion tracking before spending more?

    Why ask: If tracking is wrong, every bid and every report is wrong too. A good agency checks it first.

  5. Q5

    What will you report on each month?

    Why ask: Clicks and impressions are easy to grow. Ask for leads, sales, cost per result and what changed.

  6. Q6

    What exactly happens in the first 90 days?

    Why ask: A clear plan shows they have looked at your account. A vague answer usually means a template.

  7. Q7

    Can you show results for a business like ours?

    Why ask: Results in your industry, or with a similar sales cycle and budget, tell you far more than a list of logos.

  8. Q8

    What is the notice period, and is there a minimum term?

    Why ask: Long lock-ins protect the agency, not you. Good agencies keep clients because of results.

attrs.title: TikTok Ads questions, answered
attrs.lead: Can’t find your answer? Ask us on a free 30-minute call.

items.question: Are TikTok ads worth it?
items.answer: For brands that sell online to people under 45, often yes. TikTok reach is cheap, but it only pays if the videos are native and tracking is set up properly.

items.question: What are Spark ads?
items.answer: Spark ads promote real TikTok posts, from your account or a creator’s, as ads. They usually perform better than standard ads because they look like normal content.

items.question: Do you make the videos?
items.answer: Yes. We make videos in-house and work with creators we brief, so there are always new ads to test.

items.question: How much does TikTok Ads management cost?
items.answer: We charge a fixed monthly management fee on top of your ad spend, quoted after a free call. It depends on the size of the account and the work involved. We never take a hidden cut of your TikTok Ads spend.

items.question: Do I keep my TikTok Ads account if I leave?
items.answer: Yes. Your ads run in an account you own. You keep the account, the data and all the history.

items.question: How soon will I see results?
items.answer: Most accounts see improvements in the first month from fixing tracking and cutting waste. It usually takes two to three months of testing to settle at a good cost per result.
